name: Drift Wall
description: A wall of image-tile columns on a three-dimensional plane: each column drifts continuously up or down at its own speed, the plane tilts with the pointer, the edges fade into a radial mask, and the tile under the pointer comes forward at full color.
interactionNotes: The columns' drift is autonomous and constant; with `pauseOnHover` it stops as the pointer enters, and the column of the tile under the pointer always stops. Pointer movement tilts the plane with parallax, and the tile under the pointer comes forward by `lift`, out of the veil and into color. Tiles are focusable with Tab too.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ image: string; title?: string; href?: string }>
props.description: The wall's tiles; columns are assigned by cycling `i % columns`. `title` is the tile's accessible label and `href` is the click destination (without an `href`, the tile stays a focusable button).

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of wall columns.

props.name: tileWidth
props.description: Width of each tile in pixels.

props.name: tileHeight
props.description: Height of each tile in pixels (excluding the gap).

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between tiles in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner rounding of the tiles.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Base pitch of the plane around the X axis in degrees.

props.name: turn
props.description: Base yaw of the plane around the Y axis in degrees.

props.name: roll
props.description: Rotation of the plane around the view axis in degrees.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective viewing distance in pixels.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far the plane recedes in depth; a larger number makes the wall look farther away and smaller.

props.name: speed
props.description: Base drift speed in pixels per second; zero builds a static wall.

props.name: direction
props.description: Base drift direction; every other column always goes the opposite way.

props.name: variance
props.description: How much the column speeds differ (0 to 1); zero means all at the same speed.

props.name: parallax
props.description: How strongly the plane tilts with pointer movement; zero turns parallax off.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: On hover over the wall, all columns stop gently.

props.name: lift
props.description: Prominence of the active tile toward the viewer in pixels (translateZ).

props.name: fade
props.description: Width of the region where the edges fade (1 means no fade).

props.name: dim
props.description: Dimming of the inactive tiles; the active tile is always at full brightness.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Keep the inactive tiles black and white and color the active one.

props.name: overlayColor
props.description: Color of the veil over the inactive tiles; it goes to zero on the active tile.

tips: Zero dependencies: a self-contained rAF loop with exponential damping for the parallax and the columns' gentle stop.
Good for section backgrounds: turn `pauseOnHover` on so text over the wall stays readable, and lower `fade` so the edges fade more.
With `speed: 0` and `parallax` on, you get a static three-dimensional wall that only breathes with the pointer.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the drift stops completely (tiles stay at their offset) and parallax is off; hover and focus still work.
